data.description: Experience Ultimate Luxury in Grand Bleu Tower 1 | Emaar Beachfront
data.display_address: Grand Bleu Tower 1, Emaar Beachfront, Dubai Harbour, Dubai
data.long_description:
Grand Bleu Tower 1, situated in Dubai Harbour's Emaar Beachfront community, offers a luxurious living experience with interiors designed by the renowned fashion icon Elie Saab. This exclusive residence features spacious apartments with panoramic views of the Palm Jumeirah and the Arabian Gulf.

Key Features:

Prime Location: Located in Emaar Beachfront, residents enjoy direct access to a 1.5-kilometer private beach, providing a serene coastal lifestyle.

Elegant Interiors: Each apartment boasts meticulously crafted interiors by Elie Saab, blending contemporary design with timeless elegance.

World-Class Amenities:

Infinity swimming pools overlooking the sea.
Fully equipped gym and wellness center.
Retail and dining outlets on the podium level.
Exclusive Residences: The tower offers a range of apartment sizes, including one, two, and three-bedroom units, catering to diverse preferences and lifestyles.

Grand Bleu Tower 1 exemplifies luxury living in Dubai, combining sophisticated design with unparalleled amenities in a prime waterfront location.
